title: The effects of vitamin D on bone, muscle and adipose tissue: a randomized double-blind phase IV study
official: The effects of vitamin D on bone, muscle and adipose tissue: a randomized double-blind phase IV study
summary: Main objective: To evaluate the effect of cholecalciferol supplementation on inflammation in obese patients with vitamin D deficiency
conditions: obese elderly people with vitamin D deficiency
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Obtaining written informed consent
2. Willingness to adhere to the procedures foreseen by the study, as reported in the informed consent
3. Post-menopausal women between the ages of 55 and 75 and men of the same age for whom hip or knee replacement surgery has been scheduled
4. BMI >= 30 kg/m2
5. 25(OH)D levels < 20 ng/ml
Exclusion criteria:
1. eGFR < 40 ml/min./1.72 m2 estimated via EPI formula
2. Osteoporosis (femoral or vertebral t-score > -2.5)
3. Pathologies at the site of surgery
4. Participation in interventional clinical trials in the previous 3 months
5. Hypersensitivity to cholecalciferol or to any of the excipients
6. Hypercalcemia (>10.5 mg/dL)
7. Nephrolithiasis known by medical history
8. 4.	Conditions that can alter the metabolism of calcium and vitamin D (primary hyperparathyroidism, hyperthyroidism, chronic renal failure, liver failure, hypercortisolism, malabsorption, HIV)
9. 5.	Use of drugs that can alter bone metabolism (estrogens, raloxifene, tamoxifen, bisphosphonates, denosumab, teriparatide, GnRH analogues, use of at least 5 mg per day of glucocorticoids for ≥ 3 months, anabolic steroids, dilantin, antiretrovirals, radiation therapy)
10. Immobilized patients
11. Alcohol and/or tobacco abuse
12. Clinical history of bone metastases or neoplastic bone diseases
13. Paget's disease
